verdict.rationale: Aircall's marketing says calls, SMS and messaging live in one platform. It also describes a shared inbox that keeps every conversation visible so the team can collaborate without losing context, and says notes can be captured on calls. However, nothing shows calls and texts threaded under a single contact record with a unified history; the 'connected' framing points to external CRM integrations. Missing for 10: documented per-contact threading of calls and texts, team-visible contact notes and history inside Aircall, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform, keeping every interaction connected to your CRM, help desk, and business tools.
A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
